title: Whopping $1.818 mil transacted price for a Dawson five-room flat — all-time high in Singapore per HDB data

Show me HDB listings in Queenstown A five-room flat in Queenstown just set a fresh islandwide record for HDB resale prices — by absolute quantum and on a psf basis — when it was resold at $1.818 million ($1,521 psf) on Oct 30, going by HDB’s resale flat database. Located at Block 96 Dawson Road , part of the SkyParc @ Dawson development, the unit sits on the 40th to 42nd storeys and measures 111 sq m (1,194.8 sq ft). It has a remaining lease of around 94 years. Ted Wong of ERA Realty Network, who was the appointed agent for the seller, told EdgeProp Singapore that the unit overlooks the expansive greenery of the Dempsey area and saw high demand from prospective buyers. Read also: What's moving the market: Singapore's biggest property deals and hottest searches (Oct 30) Advertisement Advertisement "More than eight offers were received, with the top three all above $1.8 million," Wong said. He added that interested parties valued the centrality of the location, abundant amenities nearby, the view of the greenery, and the ample size of the unit. In Wong’s view, the “relatively low” supply of five-room flats in the estate also contributed to the level of interest and the record-breaking outcome. The price tag of $1.818 million surpasses the previous HDB resale record of $1.728 million , set in April 2026 when a five-room flat at Block 96A Henderson Road , part of City Vue @ Henderson in Bukit Merah, changed hands. That unit is located on the 46th to 48th floor and spans 113 sq m (1,216 sq ft). Its psf price works out to $1,421. On a psf basis, the latest SkyParc @ Dawson flat transaction also exceeds the previous islandwide high of $1,502 psf , set in September 2026. That involved a 1,065 sq ft, five-room flat at the neighbouring Block 91 Dawson Road , part of SkyTerrace @ Dawson , which had fetched $1.6 million. Within Queenstown, the previous record by absolute price was $1.7 million, held by a five-room flat sold in February this year at Block 92 Dawson Road , which is also at SkyTerrace @ Dawson. At the time, the $1.7 million transaction was the most expensive transacted HDB flat in Singapore. Top five HDB resale transactions in Queenstown planning area by transacted price
